title: Read receipt
description: Supporting record for traces. A server-issued, immutable identifier for exactly what SSoR delivered on one read: the query, its parameters, and the exact assertion versions returned. Delivery history — not the reader's learning history, and not SSoR's recording history (record time).

version.description: The exact version returned — enough to re-materialise what the reader saw. Asserting 'state as of 14:05' is not enough: the record held more than the reader was shown.

returned.description: Exactly what was delivered AFTER the audience filter (B-21).

label.description: Reads in v0.1 are labelled 'latest_known' — never 'verified_current' (B-01).
